title: What changed in the March release
dek: Offline mode, a faster inbox, and one thing we removed.

blocks.text: The March release is about two things: working without a signal, and getting requests into the plan faster.
Open the plan on a train, edit it, and close the app. Changes sync the next time your phone finds a connection.

blocks.quote: The best feature is the one you stop noticing.

blocks.title: One removal
blocks.text: We removed the calendar view. Almost nobody used it, and it slowed the app down.
